_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'We are the largest cable operator in the United States' (FY2007 10-K, Item 1); 'A substantial portion of our revenues comes from residential subscribers whose spending patterns may be affected by prevailing economic conditions. Intensifying competition and a weakening economy affected our net subscriber additions during the second half of 2007'; competitors include DBS providers, phone companies with fiber-optic networks and 'online services that offer Internet video streaming, downloading and distribution of movies, television shows and other video programming'

classification.quality_note: 'We are the largest cable operator in the United States' (FY2007 10-K, Item 1); 'A substantial portion of our revenues comes from residential subscribers whose spending patterns may be affected by prevailing economic conditions. Intensifying competition and a weakening economy affected our net subscriber additions during the second half of 2007'; competitors include DBS providers, phone companies with fiber-optic networks and 'online services that offer Internet video streaming, downloading and distribution of movies, television shows and other video programming'. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.03x; -9% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.43; conservative 2yr +107%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.7%/yr (worst year FY04-FY07, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +11.6%/yr (FY08 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 4.2-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +38.3%/yr (FY04-FY07 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +72.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY07); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2008-02-29) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.03x (13.0% downside to Bear $17 / +427.1% upside to Bull $103) | Adj composite 2.65 vs market 1.22: gap +1.43 [UNDERVALUED] | -9% above the EPP floor $21 (29x FY08E $0.74) | Conservative 2-yr case: +107.2% total (+53.6%/yr) | At 26.4x FY08E the 15% hurdle price $26 sits at or below the BASE case; video subscribers -0.7% in Q4 2007, forward revenues +8-10% (FY08 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
